message: We all arrived at the outdoor training ground.

name: Sonomi
message: 「Alright, let's get started.」
With a grin that showed she'd been waiting for this, she took up her Origami.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Muragaki-sensei, Sono-chan-senpai's Origami looks different from anything I've seen before.」

name: Iori
message: 「Ah, that is... a nagamaki. As you can see, its defining feature is the extremely long handle.」
According to one theory, it’s a weapon born from lashing a blade to a spear handle after the spearhead had been shorn off on the battlefield.
It is also said that this later evolved into the naginata.

name: Asahi
message: 「It sounds like it would require specialized techniques to handle.」

name: Iori
message: 「Indeed, the fighting style must be completely different from a regular sword. You should pay close attention; it'll be a good learning experience.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「As expected of Sono-chan-senpai！ That's so cool！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hmm... but, like, isn't that kinda lame？」

name: Iori
message: 「Hey now, Ririmu...」

name: Ririmu
message: 「No, I mean, seriously. It just looks like you made the handle longer, right？ It doesn't really match your vibe, does it？ And the balance looks off, too.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「It's a given that a swordsman should be strong, so you gotta express your worldview through how you look, too！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Mine's a custom-made job, you know？ It's all about the worldview！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Talking all that flashy trash... I don't like it. People like you are exactly what I hate most.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Next time I see your face, I'm gonna crush you.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ha？ I don't get why you're snapping at me？」
Ririmu shot a displeased glare back at the savage rage in her eyes.

name: Asahi
message: 「Ririmu-san, please leave it at that. We're just bystanders here to watch the two of them spar.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Eh~ but still~」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Damn it... Hey, Suzakuin, let's get this over with. That annoying brat is putting me in a bad mood.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Agreed. I don't want any more trouble than this, so let's start immediately.」
Momiji drew her Origami as well, preparing for combat.

name: Momiji
message: 「...I'll tell you now, I won't be holding back once we start. Be ready for that.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Of course. I'll be going all out, too.」
In response, Arakawa-san surged with energy and took up her stance anew.

name: Iori
message: 「Then... begin！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Hraaaaaagh！！」
The instant the signal sounded, Arakawa-san kicked off the ground and shot forward.
With a step so forceful it felt like the ground shook beneath our feet, she hurtled furiously toward Momiji like a bullet.

name: Momiji
message: 「Charging straight at me—」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Try and stop me！！」
Momiji's body sank slightly as she blocked the overhead blow slammed down upon her.
Because a nagamaki has a greater distance between its fulcrum and point of force, the weight behind its slashes is far heavier than that of a standard katana.
Add the momentum of that lunging charge on top of it, and not even Asahi could block it unfazed.

name: Sonomi
message: 「What's the matter?！ You're getting pushed back, honor student！！」
Next, she spun the nagamaki around and knocked Momiji's Origami upward with the butt of its hilt.
Shifting her grip seamlessly, she launched strikes and thrusts with the hilt at Momiji's off-balance body.

name: Sonomi
message: 「C'mon, c'mon! What's wrong!」
They were bludgeoning strikes and thrusts rarely ever seen in regular Jindou.
Bewildered by the unfamiliar movements, Momiji still managed to barely evade them through sheer physical ability.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Whoa, she attacks with the hilt too！」

name: Iori
message: 「Nagamaki forms incorporate staff techniques as well.」

name: Iori
message: 「It doesn't just slash—it can thrust and strike too. If you only focus on the blade, you'll get beaten flat.」
And naturally, Arakawa-san fights in a way that takes full advantage of those traits.
Just as Setsugekka was surprised, Momiji was likely bewildered right now by an opponent using forms she had never experienced before.

name: Iori
message: 「On top of that, a nagamaki is really troublesome for Momiji.」
While we were talking, Momiji retreated to put some distance between them.
Arakawa-san naturally pressed after her, only for Momiji to swing her long blade to ward her off.

name: Momiji
message: 「There！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Whoa...！ Close one, close one.」
Just before stepping into Momiji's range, Arakawa-san had halted in her tracks.
Taking an extra precaution, she backed off further, leaving about two meters of space between them.

name: Sonomi
message: 「That's a mighty long weapon you've got there, huh？ Too bad for you, though.」
Right where she stood, she raised her Origami high in a wide arc—

name: Sonomi
message: 「When you're up against me, that thing's still way too short！」
Without even taking a step forward from that spot, the swung-down blade had already reached Momiji.
Momiji looked like she couldn't believe it, though she seemed to have barely managed to block it.

name: Ririmu
message: 「No way, she can reach from that far away？！」

name: Iori
message: 「That nagamaki's total length, hilt included, is around two meters—at the very least, it's definitely longer than Momiji's long sword.」

name: Iori
message: 「If she grips the end of the hilt and swings it around, it gives her a reach that easily surpasses Momiji's long sword.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Even Momiji-san's long sword has troublesome reach, yet... that's much longer than hers, isn't it?」

name: Iori
message: 「And right now she hasn't even stepped in. That means her actual maximum reach is even longer than what we just saw.」

name: Iori
message: （Now then... how is Momiji going to handle this situation?）
Up until now, Momiji must have trained to fight by taking advantage of her long sword's reach.
Right now, however, that won't work.
A nagamaki can be gripped at the end for long range or near the base for close range; contrary to its unusual appearance, it's an all-around weapon.

name: Iori
message: （This will probably be a good experience for Momiji, for everyone watching, and for Arakawa-san, too.）
As a teacher, I can't help thinking things like that, though.

name: Sonomi
message: 「Get crushed！」
This time, a strike comes swinging down with a full step forward.
Packing even more force than before, the slash drove into the ground practically like a bludgeoning blow.
Momiji had already left that spot, leaping backward―but Arakawa―san immediately broke into a run after her.

name: Sonomi
message: 「Hraaah！」

name: Momiji
message: 「If you're coming in close...！」
Once they entered the range of her long sword, Momiji began fighting back, clashing blades with her.
However, against Arakawa-san steadily pressing in, she seemed unsure whether she should engage head-on or pull back.
And while her response remained indecisive, Arakawa-san closed the distance even further and ramped up the intensity of her assault.

name: Sonomi
message: 「Hey, what's the matter?！ Is that all you've got, Suzakuin?！」
Spinning the nagamaki, she unleashed a slash from the right, only to follow up right after with a strike from the hilt on the left.
Just when she feinted a thrust, she swept across with the blade.
Left or right, high or low, whether Momiji blocked or dodged, attacks came flying fluidly from every conceivable angle out of that nagamaki.

name: Momiji
message: 「Your fighting style is remarkably deft...！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「If you think it’s just brute force, you’d better rethink that. After I’ve crushed you into the ground！」
After shattering Momiji’s stance with a flurry of thrusts, she followed up with a high―speed sweep. Momiji managed to block it without issue, but―

name: Momiji
message: 「Ugh…！」
Every time Momiji blocked an attack, her torso wavered slightly. Sometimes, her whole body even slid back, feet and all, as she struggled to hold her ground.
That shouldn’t happen unless there was immense impact behind the blow. Even for Asahi, it would surely take a full-power strike to shake Momiji like that.
In short, it was proof of just how heavy and powerful every one of Arakawa-san’s strikes was.

name: Iori
message: （It』s certainly not *just* brute force, but… I suppose that doesn't mean she isn't capable of it.）
If anything, she was likely a pure power fighter at heart.
And yet, on top of that, she possessed a technical side that made maximum use of the advantages of her nagamaki.
An average swordsman would likely be completely helpless against her.

name: Iori
message: （I see, so that’s why she’s said to be top-class among the second-years in the Martial Arts Division.）

name: Sonomi
message: 「Hey, hey, hey, hey！」

name: Momiji
message: 「You’re so… noisy…！」
In contrast, Momiji had been forced entirely onto the defensive.
She did nothing but block and dodge Arakawa-san’s attacks.
Though she occasionally inserted a light counter, it was an ambiguous move that could be anything from a mere feint to a serious attempt.
She was likely committing herself to gathering information to sharpen the accuracy of her reads, but…

name: Iori
message: （Now then… how will she play this?）

name: Sonomi
message: 「Hrah！」
She caught the blade as it was swung down diagonally.
Arakawa-senpai’s attacks were all absurdly fast, and the way she moved made them difficult to dodge.
But above all—

name: Sonomi
message: 「There’s more where that came from！」

name: Momiji
message: （Dammit…！ This is so heavy…！）
This was the toughest part. To have this level of weight combined with such trickery was essentially foul play.
Each time she blocked, a dull, thudding shock reverberated through her body. Even though she was successfully blocking, it didn't feel like it at all.
If she took a hit like this head-on, she could lose consciousness in a single strike.

name: Momiji
message: （I guess all that posturing isn't just for show after all…）
The fact that she wielded a nagamaki was also troublesome. Until now, she had never been at a disadvantage in terms of reach.
To have the shorter reach—it was so frustrating… Now she knew how her opponents had felt when they fought her.

name: Sonomi
message: 「What's the matter? Can't even make a move, huh！?」
I dodge her transition from a hilt-strike to an upward swing, then manage to catch the follow-up diagonal slash.
My arm tingles from the impact, but there's no helping it.

name: Momiji
message: （For now, she’s coming to me on her own, but it might get more troublesome if she decides to play defensively...）
Given her personality, she likely wouldn't bunker down, but if I were to press the attack, it would inevitably force her into a defensive position.
To prevent that from happening—

name: Sonomi
message: 「Hraaaaah！」

name: Momiji
message: （A counter...！）
I dive into her guard in time with her downward strike and swipe across her torso as I dash past！
It wasn't a moment where she could dodge or defend; this should have been a direct hit—supposedly, anyway.

name: Sonomi
message: 「Hah, that didn't do jack... Not with an attack like that...！」
Even though it should have hit, she didn't flinch in the slightest, instead twisting her body and swinging her blade back around.
Fortunately, I managed to jump back and avoid it, but she just keeps charging forward without showing any sign of pain.

name: Momiji
message: 「You're stubborn... Then take this！」
As she rushes straight at me—I aim for her midline.
I bring my blade down in a line passing from her forehead to the bridge of her nose.
This is less of an attack and more of a move to make her flinch by shoving the blade right before her eyes—

name: Sonomi
message: 「Go ahead and try！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Gaaaaah！！」
It was me who got sent flying.
Even with the blade closing in on her face, she didn't look away, let alone blink—she just took the blow and unleashed a reciprocal strike without even trying to dodge.

name: Momiji
message: 「I suppose I really couldn't have predicted that...」
Thanks to leaping back in the nick of time, I managed to mitigate the force somewhat.
Even so, despite it being only a single strike, nearly half of my Barrier Jacket has been depleted.

name: Momiji
message: （What kind of power is that... such monstrous strength...）
She doesn't fear being cut—
No, more than that, she doesn't even seem to fear death. That’s the impression I’m getting.
Is she a master swordsman who thrives in life-or-death struggles, or a mad dog prowling the wilderness for prey?
She's a terrifying presence, but still—

name: Momiji
message: 「...Let's bring this to an end now.」
I’ve more or less “figured her out” now.
Sword techniques used, tactical algorithms, every physiological reaction. Psychological tendencies, personality traits, interpersonal judgment, logical reasoning ability.
Roughly all the information that constitutes the person known as Arakawa Sonomi has been accumulated within my brain.
It's not enough, but it's perfect for now.

name: Momiji
message: （…Shingan no Kiwamete, activate！）
Reading through the entire path to victory—
From this moment on, how will she move? And then next, and after that.
1st move, 2nd move, 3rd, 4th, 5th, 6th—

name: Momiji
message: （22 moves ahead… it's a long way, but I suppose that's fine. Checkmate there. The end of the match）

name: Sonomi
message: 「End, you say？ Hah, alright then, I'll bring it to an end. You're the one who's going to lose, and that'll be the end of it！」
She charges. Her speed, direction, the number of steps; everything is exactly as I predicted.
She stops on her left foot and performs a sweeping strike while stepping in with her right. The distance is 94 centimeters. I step back by exactly one and a half steps.
The tip of her blade passes two centimeters in front of me.

name: Sonomi
message: 「Hraaah！」
Immediately following, she flips the blade to strike upward from below at an angle. I step forward and counter.

name: Sonomi
message: 「Something like that, it's nothing！」
A thrust with the hilt. I twist my body to dodge it by a hair's breadth and counter.

name: Sonomi
message: 「You think you'll hit me again?！」

name: Momiji
message: 「I'm going to hit you again and again from now on—！」
I can read all of her evasions too. And I can read that my next attack will land, every single one！

name: Momiji
message: 「Still more to come, just getting started！」
Hit, hit. Avoid the counterattack. And it continues.

name: Sonomi
message: 「Don't screw with me！！」
Evasion, defense, hit, hit—！

name: Sonomi
message: 「Guh, arghhh！」
Hit, hit, hit, hit—！！！
Finally, she cries out, her movements dull, and my blade begins to carve into her body.
Everything is as read—her defense, her durability, where her movements will cease; I have read all of it completely.
And, I know exactly where she will run out of strength, everything.

name: Momiji
message: 「This is the 22nd move！」
The finishing blow cuts across her body in a diagonal slash.
With that, she doesn't even have the breath to scream; her Tenju dissipates, and she drops to her knees.
She hangs her head, leaving nothing to do but collapse.

name: Momiji
message: 「Now then, this match is—」

name: Sonomi
message: 「...What are you acting so victorious for... it isn't over yet...！」
Just as it seemed she might collapse, she suddenly raised her head.
Then, as she slowly rose to her feet, an aura of Tenju began to envelop her body, as if flames were reigniting.

name: Momiji
message: 「No way... it hasn't run out yet...！？」

name: Sonomi
message: 「The hell you think... the warm-up ends here...！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Come on, let’s go at it until we drop...！」

name: Momiji
message: 「You’re more of a stamina freak than I expected...！」
Arakawa-senpai, I can't underestimate her...！

name: Sonomi
message: 「GRAAAAAAAH！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Wait... huh？ Wasn't she about to collapse just now！？」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, for a split second, I thought her Barrier Jacket had flickered out.」
Having taken Momiji’s precise, unerring barrage of attacks head-on, Arakawa’s Tenju should have undoubtedly run out.
Yet here she was, standing once again, cloaked in surging Tenju. It didn't seem possible that she had any energy left...

name: Sonomi
message: 「What’s wrong！ Didn't you say you were going to finish me off！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Guh... still this much power...」
With the same intensity as before―no, with even greater ferocity―she launched another assault on Momiji.
Perhaps genuinely surprised, Momiji retreated while parrying the onslaught—

name: Sonomi
message: 「Not yet, this is nothing！！」
Momiji’s body was sent flying back from the impact of a strike brimming with terrifying fighting spirit.
Even after taking that many attacks from Momiji, to the point where it looked like her Tenju had run dry.
What immense strength, what monstrous stamina.
Momiji is overwhelmingly superior in swordsmanship. But in Arakawa’s case, including her Tenju, there is no telling what her limits are.
If this continues until Momiji runs out of stamina—

name: Sonomi
message: 「RRAAAAAAH！」

name: Momiji
message: 「You are... so persistent！」
Aiming for the moment Arakawa wound up, Momiji unleashed a counterattacking combo.
Every strike landed perfectly―or rather, Arakawa didn't even attempt to dodge, taking every blow head―on before buckling at the knees without ever swinging her blade down.
However—

name: Sonomi
message: 「GRAAAAAAAAAA！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Still not down...!?」
As she swung her blade upward, she stood back up once again.
Despite having taken considerable damage, she's laughing with genuine delight—and a touch of madness.

name: Sonomi
message: 「Niiice... This is what I've been waiting for...！ Come on, let's keep hacking each other up...！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Tch... You really are terribly persistent...！」

name: Iori
message: （Hmm, this might be bad...）
Watching the two of them cross blades once again, an uneasy premonition took hold of me.
For now, Momiji is still parrying Arakawa-san's slashes and slipping in counterattacks between them.
However, her breathing had gradually begun to grow ragged.
She's burning through her stamina taking Arakawa-san's heavy strikes, all while unleashing slashes of her own.
Her energy is going to run out much faster than usual.
On the other hand, Arakawa-san, who should have been cut to ribbons by now, isn't just showing zero signs of slowing down—I'd even say her edge seems to be getting sharper as time goes on.
There are tough fighters in Jindou who can take a beating, sure, but moving around after taking that much punishment isn't normal.
No half-baked training could ever get someone to this level.

name: Iori
message: （This... It's definitely not just physical strength. Mentally, too, there's probably something...）

name: Momiji
message: 「Ngh... haah, haah...」
Momiji fell back, practically knocked away, opening up some distance between them.
She reset her stance on the spot, and rather than giving chase, Arakawa-san rolled her neck with a loud, crunchy crack.

name: Sonomi
message: 「All right then... My body's finally warmed up, so how about I pay you a little return visit?」

name: Momiji
message: 「A return visit...？」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Yeah, that's right... Every single hack and slash you've dumped on me so far, I'm gonna pay you back for all of it at once！」
Just kicking off the ground sent a violent boom echoing through the air, and Arakawa-san charged straight at Momiji head-on.

name: Momiji
message: 「I'll cut you down...！」
It wasn't a speed she could dodge. Making that call, Momiji braced herself to counter.
Fixing her eyes on her charging opponent, the instant Arakawa―san entered her lethal range, she swept out with her long blade―but.

name: Sonomi
message: 「Go ahead and try！」
Without even trying to evade Momiji's counter, Arakawa-san took the slash head-on and slammed her whole body straight into her.
A brutal tackle caught Momiji dead center—

name: Sonomi
message: 「Gotcha, Suzakuin...！！」
Without missing a beat, Arakawa-san seized Momiji's dominant arm.

name: Momiji
message: 「Oh no...！」
Momiji frantically thrashed her body, trying to shake her off.
However, it had no effect on Arakawa-san, a born power fighter; no matter how hard Momiji resisted, she wouldn't budge an inch.

name: Momiji
message: 「In that case...！！」
In a split second, Momiji switched her sword to her free hand and slashed at Arakawa-san's body at point-blank range.

name: Sonomi
message: 「Told ya, it's useless！ You think I'm letting you go after getting this far...！」
Even as she was slashed and the sound of her Barrier Jacket scraping away filled the air, Arakawa-san didn't flinch.
Instead, she flashed a ferocious grin and pressed her blade against the side of Momiji's neck.

name: Momiji
message: 「What are you...！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Better surrender before your Barrier Jacket gives out, yeah？ Otherwise, your head's seriously gonna fly—！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Gyaaaaaah？！」
The blade pressed to her throat slowly drew back, letting out a deafening metallic screech.

name: Sonomi
message: 「C'mon, what's the matter！ Show me some guts！！！」
That ferocious sound, that aura, that motion―all of it looked as though she genuinely meant to slit her throat―

name: Ririmu
message: 「W-Wait, seriously？！ Is she actually doing this？！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Is that really Jindou...？！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「S-Sensei, isn't that seriously dangerous？！」

name: Iori
message: 「No... it doesn't violate the regulations.」
In the Martial Festival, grappling and chokeholds are fouls. That means grabbing an opponent and pinning them to the ground is a foul.
However, throws are not fouls. Grabbing the opponent is a means to that end, so it isn't a foul.
Therefore, as things stand―simply holding onto her opponent―it can't be ruled a foul.
As everyone else let out shriek-like cries, I watched intently.

name: Momiji
message: 「Do not... get too full of yourself...！！」
In that instant, Momiji had slipped her long blade between her own neck and the edge of the nagamaki.

name: Momiji
message: 「Cut off my head...？ Don't make me laugh...！」
With that, Momiji placed her hand against the spine of her own Origami, and—
With all her might, she shoved Arakawa-san's blade back！

name: Sonomi
message: 「Whoa...？！ You little...！」

name: Momiji
message: 「If you want a fight to the death that badly...！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Then I shall gladly oblige...！！！！」
Even watching from the sidelines, the aura she radiated was terrifying. Even Arakawa-san flinched for a split second.
Seizing that opening, Momiji swung her leg up and drove her foot straight into Arakawa-san's solar plexus.

name: Sonomi
message: 「Guh, gaaahhh……！」

name: Momiji
message: 「It’s too late to regret it now……！！」
With a front kick that seemed to shove her away, she tore Arakawa’s body from her own.

name: Momiji
message: 「I’ll be taking your life—！」
Tenju surged, and Momiji’s eyes, burning with rage, glowed golden.
As she let a terrifying bloodlust erupt from her entire body, she chased after the staggering Arakawa—

name: Momiji
message: 「――Secret Selection: Swallow Reversal！！！」
Swinging her blade up high, she slashed diagonally—
The blade had somehow flicked upwards, slicing Arakawa’s body vertically from the bottom up.
A two-stage strike delivered at a speed too fast for the eye to follow.
She traced the exact same line as the diagonal slash from above, only in reverse from below.

name: Sonomi
message: 「Gu, gahhh……！！」
Having taken a combo that should have been impossible to dodge or block, Arakawa finally collapsed to the ground, defeated.

name: Iori
message: 「……That’s enough！ Match over！」
Though I was momentarily stunned, I quickly stopped the match and rushed over.
From the others watching, I could hear sighs of relief that it was finally over.
With that at my back, as I reached the two who had finished their fight—

name: Sonomi
message: 「Not yet…… not, not yet……！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Wha…… no way……！」
Arakawa raised her voice again and started to get up.
She was clearly unsteady, hands on her knees and legs wobbling, but she still managed to stand.
Blood was streaming down from her forehead.
Momiji’s earlier combo must have pierced through her Barrier Jacket.
The second strike, coming after the Barrier Jacket had been depleted by the first, dealt direct damage to her body.
However, her Barrier Jacket had somehow recovered.

name: Momiji
message: 「You’ve got to be kidding me……？」
Momiji was genuinely taken aback, and the others all turned pale with expressions of disbelief.

name: Sonomi
message: 「That last one really stung, but…… it’s not over yet……！ I can still fight……！ Come on, let’s keep going……！」
With a twisted smirk, she still showed her will to fight.
While I admired Arakawa’s indomitable spirit, I slowly shook my head.

name: Iori
message: 「I’m sorry, but we’re ending the match here. It’s a draw.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Hah？ Shut up…！ What draw are you talking about…！ There’s no such thing in a deathmatch！」

name: Iori
message: 「You’re injured and require treatment.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「I said don’t get in my way！ You wanna get killed?！」
She tried to intimidate me, but—I shook my head once more.
Then, staring straight into her eyes, I told her slowly.

name: Iori
message: 「…Listen, this isn’t a fight to the death. As a teacher of this academy, I cannot permit this to go any further.」

name: Iori
message: 「You are a student, and I am your teacher. Sorry, but you’ll have to comply.」
It wasn't a question. It was a demand.
I kept my gaze fixed on her while I waited for a reply, just to keep her from acting out again. I didn't want to use force.
And so… after a while, Arakawa-san looked away and sheathed her Origami.

name: Sonomi
message: 「Tch… interrupting a one-on-one. How boring.」
She clicked her tongue, glared at me once, and then shifted her gaze toward Momiji.

name: Sonomi
message: 「Hey, Suzakuin. I’ll make sure to settle this score someday. I don’t accept any damn draw.」
Having spat that out, she turned on her heel and began to walk away.

name: Iori
message: 「Wait, Arakawa-san. You’re injured. Let’s go to the medical room together.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Shut it, I ain’t a kid. I’ll take care of my own business. Leave me alone.」
With a cold glare, she walked quickly out of the training grounds.
